info.name: List all available roles for a given tenant (Early Access)

params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the tenant.

params.name: name
params.description: Role name filter.

params.name: custom
params.description: Whether role is custom or not.

params.name: assignable_by_me
params.description: When true, only return roles that the current user can assign to others in the tenant.

params.name: expand_permissions
params.description: option to show all permission types

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Return the page of results immediately after this cursor

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Return the page of results immediately before this cursor

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page
